description: Discover the available and held metrics of one asset: BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, TRX, BNB, DOGE, TON, LINK, HYPE, WBTC, ADA, NEAR, XLM, BCH, LTC, UNI, AVAX, SUI, HBAR, WLD, WLFI, LIT, MNT, SHIB, QNT, ENA, MORPHO, AAVE, ONDO, DOT, ZRO, PEPE, SKY, ARB, FF, POL, APT, CRV, ZAMA, SENT, ETHFI, PENDLE, ENS, FET, LDO, EIGEN, SPX, EDGE, IMX, AXS, BAT, GRT, SYRUP, FLOKI, COMP, SAND, APE, PROM, ALT, GALA, NIL or ERA. Use it once you know the asset: asset is required, so the answer never falls back to BTC, and its rows are the same as get_metrics_list gives.
name: get_asset_metrics
title: Get asset metrics
